content: The diagnosis of Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy (DPN) involves specific clinical assessments. According to the American Diabetes Association (ADA), one of the key methods to evaluate protective sensation in patients is through the use of a 10-gram monofilament test. This test is performed to determine the presence or absence of protective sensation in the feet, which is critical for identifying the risk of foot ulcers or injuries in individuals with diabetes.
